content: 1. Rifapentine reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of levamlodipine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism in the liver and intestines. Blood pressure should be closely monitored when co-administering amlodipine with CYP3A4 inducers. Quantitative data on the effects of CYP3A4 inducers on amlodipine are not available. 2. Rifapentine decreases the levels or efficacy of levoketoconazole by enhancing CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unclear, but close monitoring is advised. 3. Rifapentine reduces the levels of levonorgestrel (both intrauterine and oral forms) by increasing CYP3A4 metabolism. This may compromise contraceptive efficacy. Alternative or backup contraception should be used during co-administration and for 28 days after discontinuing rifapentine. 4. Rifapentine decreases the levels of combined oral contraceptives (levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate) via CYP3A4 induction. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced, necessitating alternative or backup contraception. 5. Rifapentine lowers linagliptin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended when co-administering linagliptin with CYP3A4 inducers. 6. Rifapentine reduces lomitapide levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and close monitoring are required. 7. Rifapentine significantly decreases lonafarnib levels due to its sensitivity to CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is contraindicated. 8. Rifapentine reduces lopinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 9. Rifapentine decreases loratadine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 10. Rifapentine significantly reduces lorlatinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers is contraindicated. Discontinue the inducer for three plasma half-lives before initiating lorlatinib. 11. Rifapentine decreases losartan levels by inducing both CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 12. Rifapentine reduces lovastatin levels through CYP3A4 induction. Co-administration is contraindicated. 13. Rifapentine decreases lumacaftor/ivacaftor efficacy by reducing ivacaftor exposure (AUC) by 57%. Co-administration is not recommended. 14. Rifapentine reduces lumateperone levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 15. Rifapentine decreases lumefantrine levels, potentially leading to loss of antimalarial efficacy. Co-administration is contraindicated. 16. Rifapentine reduces lurasidone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. 17. Rifapentine decreases lurbinectedin levels through CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 18. Rifapentine reduces macimorelin levels, potentially causing false-positive test results. Discontinue strong CYP3A4 inducers before testing. 19. Rifapentine decreases macitentan levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 20. Rifapentine reduces maraviroc levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 21. Rifapentine decreases marijuana levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 22. Rifapentine significantly reduces mavacamten levels via CYP3A4 induction. Co-administration is contraindicated. 23. Rifapentine reduces medroxyprogesterone levels, potentially leading to contraceptive failure. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 24. Rifapentine decreases mefloquine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are advised. 25. Rifapentine reduces meloxicam levels by inducing CYP2C9 metabolism. The clinical significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 26. Rifapentine decreases mestranol levels, potentially causing contraceptive failure. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 27. Rifapentine reduces methadone levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and close monitoring are necessary. 28. Rifapentine decreases methylprednisolone levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are required. 29. Rifapentine reduces metoprolol levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 30. Rifapentine decreases midazolam levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 31. Rifapentine reduces midostaurin levels, potentially compromising efficacy. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 32. Rifapentine decreases mifepristone levels through CYP3A4 induction. Co-administration is not recommended. 33. Rifapentine reduces mirtazapine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are required. 34. Rifapentine decreases modafinil levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 35. Rifapentine reduces montelukast levels via CYP3A4 induction. The clinical significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 36. Rifapentine decreases naldemedine levels, potentially reducing efficacy. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 37. Rifapentine reduces naloxegol levels via CYP3A4 induction. Co-administration is contraindicated. 38. Rifapentine decreases nateglinide levels by inducing CYP2C9 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 39. Rifapentine reduces nefazodone levels through CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 40. Rifapentine decreases nelfinavir levels, potentially compromising efficacy. Co-administration is contraindicated. 41. Rifapentine reduces neratinib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 42. Rifapentine decreases netupitant/palonosetron levels, potentially reducing efficacy. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 43. Rifapentine reduces nevirapine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 44. Rifapentine decreases nicardipine levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are required. 45. Rifapentine reduces nifedipine levels, necessitating therapy modification and close monitoring. 46. Rifapentine decreases nilotinib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are advised. 47. Rifapentine reduces nimodipine levels through CYP3A4 induction. The clinical significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 48. Rifapentine decreases nirmatrelvir/ritonavir levels, potentially reducing efficacy. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 49. Rifapentine reduces nirogacestat levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 50. Rifapentine decreases nisoldipine levels through CYP3A4 induction. Caution and monitoring are required. 51. Rifapentine reduces nitrendipine levels via CYP3A4 induction. The clinical significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 52. Rifapentine decreases norethindrone levels, potentially causing contraceptive failure. Avoid co-administration unless benefits outweigh risks. 53. Rifapentine reduces norethindrone acetate levels, potentially compromising contraceptive efficacy. Avoid co-administration unless benefits outweigh risks. 54. Rifapentine decreases norethindrone transdermal levels, potentially leading to contraceptive failure. Avoid co-administration unless benefits outweigh risks. 55. Rifapentine reduces norgestrel levels, necessitating therapy modification and close monitoring. 56. Rifapentine decreases olaparib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 57. Rifapentine reduces oliceridine levels, potentially requiring dose adjustments. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal or respiratory depression. 58. Rifapentine decreases olutasidenib levels, potentially reducing efficacy. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 59. Rifapentine reduces omaveloxolone levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 60. Rifapentine decreases ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir & dasabuvir levels, potentially reducing efficacy. Co-administration is contraindicated. 61. Rifapentine reduces omeprazole levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 62. Rifapentine decreases ondansetron levels through CYP3A4 induction. The clinical significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 63. Rifapentine reduces osilodrostat levels, necessitating therapy modification and close monitoring.
